text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said it had assigned ratings of AA and AA minus to the A$338.2 million Class A notes and the A$2.7 million Class B notes, respectively, to be issued by a special purpose trust which will hold a portfolio of mortgages originated by Westpac Banking Corp.
The notes will be issued by the MI Trust, with the transaction structured and arranged by Westpac.
Westpac, which is based in Sydney, said on Monday it had finalised the A$340 million securitisation of a mortgage loan portfolio to Societe Generale Australia Ltd.
S&P said the transaction was the first securitisation of mortgage loans by a major Australian bank and marked the beginning of a period of increased activity in the mortgage-backed securities sector.
